args: const https = require('https'); const http = require('http'); process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8'); let input = ''; process.stdin.on('data', chunk => input += chunk); process.stdin.on('end', () => { const options = { hostname: 'your-trilium-server.example.com', port: 443, path: '/mcp', method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(input) } }; const req = https.request(options, res => { res.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk)); }); req.write(input); req.end(); });
